ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens, dark red-purple and bright green leaves with ruffled edges, covering the rim and base of a stainless steel bowl, roughly 40% of the visible area, leaves about 0.5-1 cm thick in layers, moist and crisp-looking | 120
ITEM 2 | Cubes of pale tan-cream firm block, about 1.5-2 cm per side, with slightly irregular edges, matte surface with a light sheen from dressing, scattered over the upper-middle of the greens, some cubes stacked two high | 110
ITEM 3 | Creamy pale orange-pink dressing coating the tofu cubes and pooling lightly between them, glossy and thick, clinging to the cube surfaces | 25
ITEM 4 | Thin matchstick shreds of bright orange carrot, about 4-6 cm long and 0.3 cm wide, scattered in a loose pile across the lower right of the bowl, slightly moist | 35
ITEM 5 | Thinly sliced purple cabbage shreds, deep violet with lighter edges, fine strands about 4-5 cm long, mixed loosely with the carrot and greens at the lower right | 20
ITEM 6 | Thin translucent pale onion slices or rings, white with faint purple tinge, about 3-4 cm long, scattered among the cabbage near the tofu, slightly glossy | 8
